name: io.github.sepehr071/codal-mcp
title: Codal (کدال) Disclosures
description: Read-only codal.ir: search disclosures of Iranian listed companies, read letters and statements.

environmentVariables.name: CODAL_MCP_PROXY
environmentVariables.description: Optional HTTP proxy URL for the codal.ir requests; system proxy settings are ignored. codal.ir often answers only Iranian connections. Also accepts a comma-separated list: one is used until it gets blocked or fails to connect, then the next.
